annotations.title: Create a payment session for a shipping label

description:
Turns a decided shipment into a payment session: the amount and a handoff URL to prefilled SMKlog checkout. Pass quote_id from get_parcel_quote: its price is reused, no second carrier call. Keep the returned session_id for get_checkout_status. It never charges: the human confirms contents and consents, then pays on the page.

Side effects: writes a 30-day session record; not idempotent, two calls make two sessions. No session for a non-parcel, several boxes, or an installed lithium battery crossing a border.

Parameter rules:
- A valid quote_id overrides product, from_zip, to_zip, to_country and quantity; service still applies.
- An expired quote_id reprices from the fields, or fails with missing_required_fields without them.
- service is a case-insensitive fragment of the display name; no match anchors the quote's first rate, not always the cheapest.
- from_zip: 5-digit US ZIP; to_zip follows to_country (US, CA, GB, DE, AU).
- International: customs on the page; the recipient pays duty.

from_zip.description: Origin US ZIP code, 5 digits. Required unless quote_id is given.

product.description: Plain-words item description. Required unless quote_id is given.

quantity.description: How many of the item ship together. Default 1.

quote_id.description: The quote_id returned by a previous get_parcel_quote call. Valid for 15 minutes.

service.description: Service to anchor the amount to, e.g. "USPS Ground Advantage". Omitted or unmatched, the amount anchors the quote's first rate, top of the best-value ranking rather than the cheapest; the human can still pick any service on the page.

to_country.description: Two-letter destination country: US (default), CA, GB, DE, AU.

to_zip.description: Destination postal code: a 5-digit ZIP for the US, or the destination country's own postal code. Required unless quote_id is given.

name: create_checkout_link

outputSchema.description: A payment session, not a charge: the amount and the handoff URL where the human pays. The amount is a live quote at this moment, not a hold or a reservation, and no money moves until the human completes the page.

amount.description: Live-quoted checkout total for the anchored service, USD

handoff_url.description: Opens the SMKlog checkout prefilled with this shipment

identified_product_title.description: What the estimator understood the item to be

method.description: Payment rails behind the checkout, e.g. stripe, card

note.description: Standing caveats: live quote, human confirms consents and pays

quote_reused.description: True when the amount came from a quote_id you supplied, so no carrier call was spent. False when this tool priced the shipment live -- either because no quote_id was given, or because the one given had expired.

service.description: The service the amount is anchored to

session_id.description: Handle for get_checkout_status, shaped as_ plus a UUID, good for 30 days. Null only when the session record could not be stored.
